items.title: 17.13 RLC parallel circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through an RLC parallel circuit (PDF 105-106).

blocks.text: RLC parallel circuit mein resistor, inductor aur capacitor AC source ke aar-paar aik doosre ke parallel jure hain (Fig 17.12 a). Parallel tarteeb kul impedance aur current ki taqseem badalti hai, jis se yeh series circuit se mukhtalif hai.

items: Resonance aur impedance: parallel RLC circuit XL = XC par resonate karta hai, aur tab is ki impedance zyada se zyada aur yeh sirf resistance wale circuit ki tarah hota hai. Impedance Z = 1 / [(1/R)^2 + (1/XL - 1/XC)^2] ka square root (17.27).

Voltage aur current: har hisse par voltage aik hai, is liye ise hawala phasor liya jata hai. Resonance par source se line current kam se kam hota hai (Fig 17.12 b), jab ke shaakh ke currents IL aur IC alag alag is se bare ho sakte hain; is se current barhaya ja sakta hai.
Admittance: admittance Y impedance ka ulat hai, Y = 1/Z; parallel circuit ki kul admittance us ki shaakhon ki admittances ka jor hai.

Frequency aur bandwidth: impedance, admittance aur currents sab frequency par munhasir hain; bandwidth frequencies ki woh had hai jis mein circuit achha kaam kare. Resonant frequency fr = 1/(2 pi x (LC) ka square root).
Quality factor (Q): resonance chotti ki tezi ka paimana, circuit mein jama tawanai aur zaya tawanai ka muqabla.
Power factor: frequency aur reactances ke tanasub ke saath badalta; resonance par 1.

blocks.title: Parallel circuit ka Q
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke parallel RLC circuit mein Q-factor resistance ke ulat mutanasib hai. Parallel circuit ke liye ulat sach hai: Q = R x (C/L) ka square root, jo R ke saath barhta hai (zyada parallel resistance kam current zaya karti). Series circuit mein, Q = (1/R) x (L/C) ka square root, R barhne se Q ghatta hai. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

blocks.alt: (a) AC source ke aar-paar parallel jure R, L aur C; line current I oopar ki taar mein aur neeche se wapas, aur shaakh currents IR, IL aur IC teen shaakhon se neeche. (b) Current I aur frequency: hamwar U-numa lakeer jis ka sab se nichla nuqta, resonance current Ir, resonance frequency fr par hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.12 (a), (b): (a) AC source se jura RLC parallel circuit; (b) resonance frequency aur resonance current Ir ka graph (kitab ki Figure 17.12 (a), (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Parallel circuit mein resonance par impedance sab se zyada hoti hai, is liye line current I sab se kam (Ir) hota hai: graph neeche ki taraf jhukta hai. Series circuit mein ulat hai: wahan resonance par current sab se zyada hota hai (Fig 17.11 d).

Parallel RLC circuits tuning circuits, signal processing aur power systems mein use hote hain. Induction cooktops (Fig 17.12 c, tasveer) mein parallel RLC circuit ki resonance coil mein zyada frequency ka current chalati hai, jo dhaat ke bartan mein currents paida kar ke use garam karta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Electrocardiogram (ECG) dil ki sargarmi ke dauran paida hone wali chhoti bijli ki lehrein record kar ke dil ki bimariyon ki tashkhees mein use hota hai, jo cathode-ray oscilloscope ya screen par dikhayi jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Resonance par series aur parallel RLC circuits mein line current mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Series circuit mein impedance kam se kam (Z = R), is liye current zyada se zyada; parallel circuit mein impedance zyada se zyada, is liye line current kam se kam hai.

items: Parallel RLC: har shaakh par aik voltage; Z = 1/sqrt((1/R)^2 + (1/XL - 1/XC)^2).
Resonance (XL = XC): Z zyada se zyada, line current kam se kam; fr = 1/(2 pi sqrt(LC)).
Admittance Y = 1/Z; istemal: tuning, induction cooktops.
